title: Live Auth Battle Test v1
description: Machine-readable live auth battle test gate. Honestly documents which OAuth/flows are live-tested vs fake/deferred, credential storage posture, safety boundaries, and supported/rejected claims to produce a promote/promote_with_limitations/hold recommendation.
